comment: The DSP is the Renaissance alternative firmware for Braids, vendored at alt_firmware/renaissance; src/contextus.cpp is the Rack wrapper, running one macro oscillator per polyphonic channel. It carries 57 models against Nodi's 47: it adds two Software Automated Mouth speech models, five diatonic chord models and five six-oscillator stack models, replaces the four-voice wavetable model with a chord version of it, and drops the QPSK model and the Morse code easter egg along with the MORS button. There is a twenty-fifth parameter, PARAM_META at index 19, kept only so that older patches still load; it has no widget on the panel, is read nowhere in the module, and cannot be clicked. Every per-channel read uses getVoltage(channel) rather than getPolyVoltage(channel), so a monophonic cable patched to META, TIMBRE, COLOR or FM drives the first channel alone while the rest keep their knob values. The hardware firmware's option to reverse the model encoder is not offered here. The trigger threshold is 1V.
